meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Bank credit by state and union territory (place of sanction), every quarter since March 2014
meta.note: RBI BSR-1 quarterly (DBIE 943), outstanding credit of scheduled commercial banks excluding RRBs, as at the end of each quarter (dated to that month). Amounts and limits in ₹ lakh crore; accounts in lakh. States are as the RBI lists them in each quarter: Telangana from December 2014, Ladakh from December 2019, and Dadra and Nagar Haveli with Daman and Diu merged from March 2020. Andhra Pradesh and Jammu and Kashmir before those dates are larger units than after, so read their series across those quarters as two.
